# Vamos UI — component catalog

142 components. Install any of them with `npx vamos-ui add <name>`; read the full API with `npx vamos-ui view <name>` or the MCP tool `get_item`. Each name links to its docs page.

Columns: **Use when** is the first whenToUse rule and **Avoid when** the first avoidWhen rule from registry/guidance/<name>.json; `get_item` returns all of them plus accessibility notes.

## Foundations

| Name | What it is | Use when | Avoid when | Related |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`avatar`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/avatar) | A person or organisation: photo with a locale-correct initials fallback, a colour derived from the name, five sizes, a square shape for logos, a… | Representing a person or organisation in rows, cards, comments, pickers and menus. | Decorative illustrations or product images — use Image. | `user-picker`, `entity-card`, `item`, `hover-card` |
| [`badge`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/badge) | A small label for status, counts and tags — and the kit's removable chip, reused by Tag input, Combobox and Filter bar. | Short status, count or tag labels: Draft, Overdue, 12, VIP. | Clickable actions — use Button. | `status-picker`, `tag-input`, `filter-bar`, `avatar` |
| [`button`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/button) | Triggers an action. Eight variants, nine sizes, a loading state that keeps the layout stable, and the option to render as another element (asChild). | Every action: save, create, submit, open a dialog. | Navigating to another page in body text — use a link. | `button-group`, `dropdown-menu`, `tooltip`, `kbd` |
| [`button-group`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/button-group) | ButtonGroup merges related buttons into one control — a split Publish ▾, pager arrows, a search field with its button. | A split button (Publish ▾), pager arrows, or an input attached to its button. | Unrelated actions side by side — use separate Buttons. | `button`, `tabs`, `radio-group`, `dropdown-menu` |
| [`kbd`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/kbd) | Shows keyboard keys and shortcuts. Platform-aware: mod renders as ⌘ on Apple devices and Ctrl elsewhere, with spoken key names for screen readers. | Showing keyboard shortcuts in menus, tooltips, help and command palettes. | Code snippets — use Code from Typography. | `tooltip`, `command`, `dropdown-menu` |
| [`separator`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/separator) | A hairline divider between content: card sections, menu and toolbar groups, the "or" on a sign-in form. | A hairline between card sections, menu and toolbar groups, the or on sign-in forms. | Spacing that whitespace can do alone. | `card`, `dropdown-menu`, `button-group` |
| [`skeleton`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/skeleton) | Placeholders while content loads. Skeletons are hidden from assistive tech; SkeletonGroup announces the region once. | Placeholders while content loads in known shapes: rows, cards, charts. | Short waits under ~300ms — show nothing. | `spinner`, `progress`, `empty-state` |
| [`spinner`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/spinner) | An indeterminate loading indicator: a thin track with a rotating, breathing arc. | Indeterminate loading for short waits inside buttons, panels or overlays. | Known-shape content loading — use Skeleton. | `skeleton`, `progress`, `button` |
| [`typography`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/typography) | One typographic language bound to the data-font axis: Heading (level and size decoupled), Text with sizes, tones and truncation, Lead, Code… | All text: Heading (level and size decoupled), Text, Lead, Code, Blockquote, Numeric, Prose. | Raw font-family or arbitrary font sizes — use the type scale tokens. | `page-header`, `rich-text-section`, `kbd` |

## Forms & inputs

| Name | What it is | Use when | Avoid when | Related |

| [`address-field`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/address-field) | A structured postal address in one fieldset: country, then province and district pickers for countries with region data (Türkiye's 81 provinces and… | Postal, billing or shipping addresses on customer, company, branch or invoice forms. | A single free-text location like a meeting place — use Input. | `input`, `combobox`, `select`, `map-hours` |
| [`checkbox`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/checkbox) | Independent yes/no choices and multi-select: consent, row selection, permissions, modules. | Independent yes/no choices: consent, opt-ins, module selection. | Exactly one of several options — use Radio Group. | `radio-group`, `switch`, `combobox`, `permission-matrix` |
| [`color-picker`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/color-picker) | Choose a colour — website brand colour, label colours, campaign or chart series colour. | Choosing a brand, label, campaign or chart series colour. | Theming the app itself — set data-accent or --accent-base instead of a free colour. | `select`, `font-picker`, `settings-02` |
| [`combobox`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/combobox) | Searchable selection — single or multiple, static or server-backed, optionally creatable: country, assignee, labels, category. | More than about 10 options, or when typing helps: country, assignee, category, labels. | Fewer than 6 options — use Radio Group; 6–10 fixed options — use Select. | `select`, `record-picker`, `user-picker`, `tag-input`, `radio-group` |
| [`file-upload`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/file-upload) | Pick or drop files, watch them upload with progress, retry failures, remove or cancel. | Picking or dropping files with progress, retry and cancel: documents, imports, attachments. | A single image with crop and focal point — use Image field. | `image-field`, `media-picker`, `attachment-list`, `import-wizard` |
| [`font-picker`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/font-picker) | Choose a typeface from a curated catalog of 59 Google Fonts families — searchable, grouped by category, every row previewed in its own face — or one… | Choosing a website typeface or a type pairing in appearance settings. | Changing the app's own type — set the data-font axis. | `color-picker`, `settings-02`, `onboarding-02`, `typography` |
| [`formatted-input`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/formatted-input) | Business inputs that format while you type without moving the caret: money, numbers and percentages with locale separators, phone numbers with a… | Business inputs that format while typing: money, numbers, percentages, phone (E.164), IBAN, national/tax IDs. | Plain text — use Input. | `input`, `line-items`, `address-field` |
| [`input`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/input) | Text input, multi-line textarea, and Field, which wraps any control with a label, hint and error and wires the accessibility attributes through… | Single-line and multi-line text entry; Field wraps any control with label, hint and error. | Formatted business values (money, phone, IBAN) — use Formatted inputs. | `formatted-input`, `select`, `combobox`, `tag-input`, `slug-input` |
| [`input-otp`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/input-otp) | One-time code entry for 2FA sign-in, SMS verification, customer-portal email codes and payment confirmation. | One-time codes: 2FA sign-in, SMS verification, email codes, payment confirmation. | Passwords or general text — use Input. | `otp-01`, `input`, `magic-link-01` |
| [`line-items`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/line-items) | Editable product and service rows — item, quantity, unit, price, discount, tax rate and a generic withholding field — with exact totals per tax rate. | Quotes, invoices and orders with product/service rows, discounts and tax rates. | Read-only small lists of numbers — use Table. | `formatted-input`, `detail-03`, `table` |
| [`radio-group`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/radio-group) | Pick exactly one of a small set — post visibility, invoice type, a plan. | Exactly one of a small set (2–5) that should all be visible: visibility, invoice type, plan. | More than ~6 options — use Select or Combobox. | `select`, `checkbox`, `combobox`, `button-group` |
| [`select`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/select) | Pick one of a small, fixed set — content status, currency, department, sort order. | One of a small fixed set (about 4–10): content status, currency, department, sort order. | More than ~10 options or typing helps — use Combobox. | `combobox`, `radio-group`, `dropdown-menu`, `input` |
| [`signature-pad`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/signature-pad) | Capture a handwritten or typed signature: delivery confirmations, consent forms, timesheet sign-off, customer approvals. | Handwritten or typed signatures: delivery confirmations, consent forms, timesheet sign-off. | Legal e-signature flows that need certified providers. | `checkbox`, `multi-step-form` |
| [`slider`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/slider) | Choose a number or a range by dragging: a price filter, a salary band, deal probability, image opacity. | Choosing a number or range by dragging: price filter, salary band, probability, opacity. | Exact values typed by users — use Formatted inputs. | `formatted-input`, `filter-bar`, `radio-group` |
| [`slug-input`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/slug-input) | A URL segment derived from a title with locale transliteration — "İşe Alım & Oryantasyon" becomes ise-alim-ve-oryantasyon in Turkish. | URL segments derived from a title with locale transliteration. | General text — use Input. | `input`, `editor-01`, `link-previews` |
| [`switch`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/switch) | An on/off setting that applies immediately: maintenance mode, online bookings, active/inactive in a table row. | On/off settings that apply immediately: maintenance mode, online bookings, active in a row. | Choices submitted with a form — use Checkbox. | `checkbox`, `settings-layout`, `radio-group` |
| [`tag-input`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/tag-input) | Free-form multi-value entry: post tags, contact segments, skills, invoice recipients, keywords. | Free-form multi-value entry: post tags, segments, skills, recipients, keywords. | Choosing from a fixed list — use Combobox with multiple. | `combobox`, `badge`, `input` |

## Overlays & feedback

| Name | What it is | Use when | Avoid when | Related |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`alert`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/alert) | A persistent inline status message in a page, card or form: an unsaved revision, a missing tax ID, a filing deadline, a subscription banner. | A persistent inline status in a page, card or form: unsaved revision, missing tax ID, trial ending. | Feedback after an action that should not stay — use Toast. | `toast`, `alert-dialog`, `empty-state`, `announcement-bar` |
| [`alert-dialog`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/alert-dialog) | Confirms an irreversible or high-stakes action. role="alertdialog", the overlay never closes it, and a danger tone puts focus on Cancel so a stray… | Confirming irreversible or high-stakes actions: delete workspace, cancel subscription, revoke access. | Reversible actions — do it immediately and offer Undo in a Toast. | `dialog`, `toast`, `button` |
| [`command`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/command) | Keyboard navigation, actions and record search from anywhere. | A ⌘K palette for navigation, actions and record search across the app. | The main navigation — use Sidebar; ⌘K is a shortcut, not the only path. | `app-shell`, `combobox`, `kbd`, `top-bar` |
| [`context-menu`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/context-menu) | A right-click (or long-press) menu for files, kanban cards, chart nodes and table rows. | Right-click or long-press actions on files, kanban cards, tree nodes and table rows. | The only way to reach an action — always also offer a visible ⋯ Dropdown Menu. | `dropdown-menu`, `kanban`, `tree-view`, `data-table` |
| [`dialog`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/dialog) | A focused task that keeps the user in context — new contact, insert link, leave request. | A focused task that keeps context: new contact, insert link, invite members, leave request. | Destructive confirmations — use Alert Dialog. | `alert-dialog`, `sheet`, `popover`, `users-roles-01` |
| [`dropdown-menu`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/dropdown-menu) | A list of actions attached to a button: the row "⋯" menu, "New ▾", the user menu, column visibility. | Actions attached to a button: row ⋯ menu, New ▾, user menu, column visibility. | Choosing a form value — use Select or Combobox. | `context-menu`, `button-group`, `select`, `command` |
| [`empty-state`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/empty-state) | Points to the next step when a list is empty, a search finds nothing, access is denied or something failed. | A list with no records yet, a search with no results, no permission, or a failed load. | Loading — use Skeleton. | `skeleton`, `alert`, `empty-01`, `empty-02`, `no-access-01` |
| [`hover-card`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/hover-card) | A rich preview when the pointer rests on a name or link: an author, a CRM contact, an @mention. | A rich preview when hovering a name or link: author, CRM contact, @mention. | Essential information or actions — touch and keyboard users must also reach it. | `tooltip`, `popover`, `entity-card`, `avatar` |
| [`notification-center`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/notification-center) | An in-app inbox: the bell with an unread badge, a panel (popover on desktop, sheet on phones) with filter tabs, a feed grouped by day, read/unread… | An in-app inbox behind a bell: mentions, approvals, assignments. | Immediate action feedback — use Toast. | `toast`, `top-bar`, `activity-timeline`, `item` |
| [`popover`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/popover) | Small interactive content anchored to a trigger: a quick form, a picker, a list. | Small interactive content anchored to a trigger: a quick form, a picker, a filter. | Short non-interactive labels — use Tooltip. | `tooltip`, `dialog`, `dropdown-menu`, `hover-card` |
| [`progress`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/progress) | Task progress and quota use — uploads, imports, leave balance, plan limits. | Task progress and quota use: uploads, imports, leave balance, plan limits. | Spinners for short waits — use Spinner. | `spinner`, `gauge`, `skeleton`, `setup-checklist` |
| [`sheet`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/sheet) | An edge panel that keeps the list behind it in view — quick edit, record preview, mobile filters and navigation. | An edge panel that keeps the list in view: quick edit, record preview, mobile filters and navigation. | Blocking confirmations — use Alert Dialog. | `dialog`, `resizable`, `app-shell`, `filter-bar` |
| [`toast`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/toast) | Reports the result of an action without interrupting: "Post published · View", "Moved to trash · Undo". | Results of an action without interrupting: Post published · View, Moved to trash · Undo. | Errors that block progress — use Alert inline. | `alert`, `notification-center`, `alert-dialog` |
| [`tooltip`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/tooltip) | A short label for icon buttons, abbreviations and disabled actions. | Short labels for icon buttons, abbreviations and disabled actions. | Essential information — tooltips never show on touch. | `hover-card`, `popover`, `kbd`, `button` |

## Navigation

| Name | What it is | Use when | Avoid when | Related |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`accordion`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/accordion) | Collapsible sections for FAQs, policy pages, editor side panels and the mobile menu. | FAQs, policy pages and long help text where readers scan headings and open one or two answers. | Content everyone must read — show it inline instead of hiding it. | `tabs`, `faq`, `editor-layout` |
| [`breadcrumb`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/breadcrumb) | Shows where a page sits in a hierarchy and offers a way up. | Pages deep in a hierarchy: Settings › Billing › Invoices, a CRM record under its company. | Top-level pages with no parent. | `page-header`, `page-intro`, `navigation-menu` |
| [`navigation-menu`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/navigation-menu) | A website's top navigation with dropdown and mega-menu panels, a floating glass variant, and a matching mobile sheet — all from one nav array. | Website navigation with dropdowns and mega-menu panels, plus a matching mobile sheet. | Admin panels — use Sidebar. | `navbar`, `sidebar`, `breadcrumb` |
| [`pagination`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/pagination) | Page through long lists. Numbered pages with a stable width, a table footer bar with "1–20 of 312" and rows per page, SEO-friendly links, and cursor… | Paging long lists and search results; a table footer with range and rows per page. | Short lists that fit — show everything. | `data-table`, `blog-list`, `table` |
| [`sidebar`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/sidebar) | The primary app navigation, dark in both themes. | Primary app navigation with sections, submenus, flyouts and a collapsible rail. | Websites — use Navbar or Navigation Menu. | `app-shell`, `top-bar`, `shell-01`, `shell-02`, `shell-04` |
| [`stepper`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/stepper) | Shows position and status in an ordered process — import wizards, onboarding, approvals, checkout. | Showing position and status in an ordered process: import wizard, onboarding, approvals, checkout. | Approvals with approvers — use Approval flow. | `multi-step-form`, `approval-flow`, `import-wizard`, `steps` |
| [`tabs`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/tabs) | Switch between views of the same context — a record's sections, status filters, a List/Grid switch. | Switching between views of the same context: record sections, status filters, List/Grid. | Sequential steps — use Stepper. | `accordion`, `saved-views`, `button-group`, `page-header` |
| [`top-bar`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/top-bar) | The sticky bar above the content: mobile menu button, a ⌘K search trigger, contextual actions, notifications and the user menu. | The sticky bar above app content: mobile menu, ⌘K search, actions, notifications, user menu. | Website headers — use Navbar. | `app-shell`, `sidebar`, `notification-center`, `command` |

| [`saved-views`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/saved-views) | Named list configurations — “My open deals”, “Probation ending”, “Partners at risk” — as tabs above any list. | Named list configurations as tabs: My open deals, Probation ending. | Fixed status filters — use Tabs. | `data-table`, `filter-bar`, `tabs`, `list-01` |
| [`stat`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/stat) | One metric with its change and a mini trend: KPI rows, dashboard tiles, record summaries. | One metric with change and trend: dashboard KPI rows, record summaries. | Time series details — use a chart. | `sparkline`, `chart`, `stats-band`, `dashboard-01` |
| [`table`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/table) | Styled semantic table primitives for small and static data — invoice lines, settings lists, chart data. | Small, static data: invoice lines, settings lists, chart data tables. | Sorting, filtering, selection or large datasets — use Data Table. | `data-table`, `description-list`, `line-items` |
| [`task-list`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/task-list) | Checkable tasks with assignee, due date, priority and subtasks: deal follow-ups, onboarding, an editorial checklist, project to-dos. | Checkable tasks with assignee, due date, priority and subtasks: follow-ups, onboarding, checklists. | Project plans with dates and dependencies — use Gantt. | `setup-checklist`, `kanban`, `gantt`, `detail-01` |
| [`tree-view`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/tree-view) | Display and navigate hierarchies — a CMS page tree, category tree, media folders, a department tree, file explorer panes. | Displaying and navigating hierarchies: page tree, categories, media folders, departments. | Picking a value in a form — use Tree select. | `tree-select`, `hierarchy-chart`, `sortable-list` |
| [`version-history`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/version-history) | Revisions of a record: pick two, see what changed and restore an older one. | Revisions of a record: compare two versions, see word-level changes, restore. | Event history without content diffs — use Activity timeline. | `activity-timeline`, `audit-log`, `editor-layout` |

## Charts

| Name | What it is | Use when | Avoid when | Related |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`area-chart`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/area-chart) | Volume or trend over time — traffic, pipeline value, headcount. | Volume or cumulative trend over time: traffic, pipeline value, headcount. | Comparing rates or many overlapping series — use Line chart. | `line-chart`, `bar-chart`, `chart`, `sparkline`, `stat` |
| [`bar-chart`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/bar-chart) | Category comparison — columns or ranked rows, grouped, stacked or 100% stacked, with highlight, value labels and a zero line for negatives. | Comparing values across categories: revenue by channel, deals by owner, headcount by department. | Trends over continuous time — use Line or Area chart. | `line-chart`, `donut-chart`, `funnel`, `chart`, `combo-chart` |
| [`chart`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/chart) | The shell every chart shares: series mapped to colour tokens, locale-aware formatting, an interactive legend, loading / refreshing / empty / error… | Custom charts that need the shared frame: token colours, legend, loading/empty/error states, text summary. | A single number — use Stat. | `area-chart`, `bar-chart`, `line-chart`, `donut-chart`, `stat` |
| [`combo-chart`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/combo-chart) | Volume and rate together: bars on the start axis, a line on the end axis. | Volume and rate together: orders as bars with conversion rate as a line. | Two measures with the same unit — use a grouped Bar chart or Line chart. | `bar-chart`, `line-chart`, `chart` |
| [`donut-chart`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/donut-chart) | Parts of a whole, up to about six slices. | Parts of a whole with up to about six slices: employment type, traffic source share. | More than six categories or close values — use Bar chart or Bar list. | `bar-chart`, `chart`, `stat` |
| [`funnel`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/funnel) | Stage-by-stage conversion as aligned bars: each stage's value, conversion from the previous stage, drop-off, overall rate and an optional amount. | Stage-by-stage conversion: leads → qualified → won, visit → cart → checkout. | Unordered category comparison — use Bar chart. | `bar-chart`, `dashboard-02`, `kanban` |
| [`gauge`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/gauge) | A score or attainment on a 180° / 270° arc with threshold bands and a target marker, and a full ring for progress to a goal — from a 20 px table-cell… | A score or attainment against a target: quota, NPS, SLA. | Comparing several values — use Bar list. | `progress`, `stat`, `chart` |
| [`heatmap`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/heatmap) | Density patterns as tinted cells: a calendar (weeks × weekdays — publishing, activity, attendance) or a matrix (weekday × hour, department × month). | Density patterns: activity calendars, publishing frequency, weekday × hour traffic. | Exact comparisons between a few values — use Bar chart. | `calendar`, `bar-chart`, `chart` |
| [`line-chart`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/line-chart) | Multi-series trends and rates — conversion, win rate, turnover. | Multi-series trends and rates: conversion, win rate, turnover. | Volumes or cumulative totals — use Area chart. | `area-chart`, `combo-chart`, `chart`, `sparkline` |
| [`sparkline`](https://ui.vamos.ist/docs/components/sparkline) | An axis-less mini trend in plain SVG — light enough for a hundred table rows. | Axis-less mini trends in table rows, KPI tiles and record summaries. | Trends users must read precisely — use Line or Area chart. | `stat`, `line-chart`, `data-table` |
